subject: MSA redline + Order Form: portal signer delegation, bank proof, PO-ACK SLA exception

Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 21 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA redline + Order Form: portal signer delegation, bank proof, PO-ACK SLA exception

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. Per our discussion, attached is the MSA with a handful of redlines and a draft Order Form (see Apri_MSARedline_20250921.docx and PO-ACK-SLA-Statement.xlsx). A few specific asks to keep this moving on your side: 

- Can your AP team confirm whether ApriCorps will be enrolled in Ariba or Coupa? If you use both, please indicate the primary vendor portal and vendor ID we should map.
- For bank/wiring proof: we typically need a bank letter or bank statement with account name and last 4 digits. If you prefer to send a redacted copy, we can accept it with an attestation from your CFO.
- Signatory delegation: our standard requires the person who executes the Order Form to be an authorized signatory. You mentioned a delegated Director signs on procurement tickets — would you be able to provide a POA or an authorization email from legal?
- PO-ACK SLA: Our standard is 48h for PO acknowledgement in the portal; you requested 72h during call. Please confirm if 72h is a hard requirement so we can note a temporary exception in the Order Form.

If convenient, please upload the insurance certificate and bank proof to your vendor profile in Ariba/Coupa and reply here. I’ve looped in Kimberly (legal) and Marissa (onboarding ops) to address redline questions and the portal mapping.

Next step: once we have bank proof and insurance, Kimberly will advise on the indemnity/ liability redline. If we can align on signer delegation and bank proof, I’ll push DocuSign for the Order Form.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Partnerships Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Apri_MSARedline_20250921.docx, PO-ACK-SLA-Statement.xlsx
From: Sara Lam <sara.lam@apricorps.com>

Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: MSA redline + Order Form: portal signer delegation, bank proof, PO-ACK SLA exception

Hi Dylan —

Thanks for the note and the packets. Attachments here: Vendor-Insurance-Certificate.pdf and a redacted copy of our bank confirmation (Bank-Proof-Redacted.pdf). A few items from ApriCorps side: 

- We are primarily on Ariba — vendor ID 47219. We do have a legacy Coupa instance but all new vendors go via Ariba.
- Our procurement policy allows Director-level delegation for procurement under $250k, but legal requires a signed POA for delegated signing authority when the counterparty requests it. I’ve looped in Mark from Apri Legal to confirm we can provide a POA.
- On the indemnity cap in your MSA: our legal is asking for mutual indemnity with a limitation equal to total fees paid in the 12 months preceding a claim; Mark will propose alternative language.
- 72h PO-ACK is preferred but not a blocker; we can do 48h for the initial POs if required, though we’d like the 72h window for recurring invoices.

I’ll upload the insurance cert and the bank redaction to our Ariba vendor profile today. Once Kimberly confirms the redline pathway, we’ll route signature per the POA process.

Best,
Sara Lam
Procurement Lead | ApriCorps

Attachments: Vendor-Insurance-Certificate.pdf, Bank-Proof-Redacted.pdf
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Subject: RE: MSA redline + Order Form: portal signer delegation, bank proof, PO-ACK SLA exception

Dylan / Marissa —

I reviewed Apri’s redlines and the materials Sara uploaded. Summary and suggested path: 

1) Indemnity / liability cap: Apri’s ask for cap = 12 months fees is higher than our default (6 months). Counsel is willing to move to a 12-month cap for this account given strategic fit, provided we add carveouts for gross negligence/willful misconduct and keep IP infringement indemnity uncapped. I will prepare a short amendment phrasing.

2) Bank proof: the redacted bank proof is okay if accompanied by a CFO attestation email confirming the account details (name, last 4 digits). If they provide an unredacted bank letter via secure upload to Ariba, that’s preferable for the payments team.

3) Signer delegation: acceptable if Apri supplies a POA or authorization letter from legal indicating the Director’s delegated signing authority. If POA is delayed, we can accept a countersigned authorization email from an authorized signatory as a temporary measure for initial POs.

4) PO-ACK SLA: legal has no hard objection to 72h for this account; product/onboarding should confirm operational impact (batching and acknowledgement windows). Marissa, can you confirm whether 72h is workable for our billing flow? Mateo, FYI on Ariba vendor ID mapping — ensure vendor ID 47219 maps to their profile and that insurance and bank docs are attached.

I’ve attached Legal-Redline-Notes.pdf with inline clause suggestions. If Apri provides POA and CFO attestation within 72 hours, we can sign Order Form with the 72h SLA noted as an exception. Otherwise we default to 48h.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

Hi Sara —

Great, thanks for the upload and for looping Mark in. Next steps we agreed internally and items for you to action: 

1) Please confirm in Ariba vendor 47219 that the Vendor Insurance Certificate and Bank-Proof-Redacted.pdf are attached and visible to our onboarding team.
2) If available, please provide the signed POA or a legal authorization email for the Director-level signer. If not, the CFO attestation to accompany the redacted bank proof will suffice for initial onboarding.
3) We will move forward with a conditional Order Form reflecting a 72h PO-ACK SLA for ApriCorps as an account-level exception. We’ll include Kimberly’s carveouts to the indemnity cap.

I’ll send the Order Form via DocuSign once we receive the POA/CFO attestation (or confirmation of documents in Ariba). DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/envelope?envelopeId=abc123def

I’ve created an internal ticket SUP-4321 to track the Ariba mapping and docs ingestion; Mateo will pick up on the vendor ID mapping.
